description: (Na)₂DyCuCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a DyCuCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the DyCuCl₆ framework, Dy is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form DyCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CuCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Dy-Cl bond lengths are 2.62 Å. Cu is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form CuCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent DyCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Cu-Cl bond lengths are 2.51 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Dy and one Cu atom.
